_sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 999.5010X231.A1.xml — downloaded and read directly in full (1283 lines, small enough for a complete direct read, avoiding the AI-summarization risk the 835 work hit on a larger file), the same IG-specific ground-truth class already proven for 835.

Loop structure confirmed: HEADER (a PyX12 wrapper, not a real X12 loop — same category as ISA_LOOP/GS_LOOP/ST_LOOP, per this project's own established convention) contains AK1, then a repeating 2000 loop (AK2 + a repeating 2100 loop [IK3, two distinct CTX occurrences — see segments/CTX.json's own note — plus a repeating 2110 loop (IK4 + CTX)] + a trailing IK5), then AK9. DETAIL and FOOTER (Table 2/3) are both usage=N (Not Used) for this transaction set per the map itself — 999 is genuinely a Table-1-only document, nothing to model there.

TA1 (Interchange Acknowledgement) deliberately NOT modeled, same reasoning as 835's own precedent: it's a receiver-side response to the ORIGINAL interchange envelope, not part of a 999's own ST...SE payload this engine builds/parses.

A real structural finding this file's own authoring surfaced: IK5 sits AFTER its parent loop's nested 2100 loop closes, not before it like every segment in 835's own loop tree — required adding X12LoopDef.TrailerSegmentIDs (edi/schema_types.go), the loop-level counterpart to X12TransactionSetDef's existing Header/Trailer split, since the engine previously only supported a loop's own segments preceding its children. See CLAUDE.md's EDI Phase 2 section.
